meta.illustrativeNote: Illustrative data. This demonstration is not connected to Karnataka Government systems.
meta.boundaryNote: District boundaries follow the Census 2011 outline. Vijayanagara is not drawn separately on this illustrative map.
meta.stageNote: Cess assessed, collected, remitted and credited are separate stages. They are not added together.

exceptions.title: Cess collected but not reconciled
exceptions.description: Collected cess in the selected period has no matching remittance or credit record. This is a potential exception for review, not a confirmed violation.

exceptions.title: Projects without matched cess assessment
exceptions.description: Construction projects have no matched cess assessment in the selected period. This is a potential exception for review, not a confirmed violation.

exceptions.title: Pending welfare applications
exceptions.description: Welfare applications have remained pending beyond the prescribed processing time.

exceptions.title: Delayed departmental data updates
exceptions.description: Department feeds were not received by the expected refresh time. Figures drawn from these feeds may be incomplete.

exceptions.title: Construction safety incidents
exceptions.description: Construction safety incidents recorded in the selected period. The count is illustrative and is not a compliance finding.
